text:
Testing is a vital part of creating good software. It helps developers find problems early and improve their work. There are different types of tests, each with a specific job. Unit tests check small parts of the code in isolation, while integration tests ensure that different parts work together smoothly as a whole.

One popular method is test-driven development, where you write a test before you even write the code that makes it pass. This sounds strange, but it forces you to think carefully about what you’re building. The biggest benefit of testing is confidence. With a strong test suite, you can change or add features without fear of breaking something that already works.
